title: huge pillows
text: huge pillows. hoping to find the alternative feather pillow that flattens for stomach and side sleepers, but this was one for putting behind you on the bed to read. it's huge once it's expanded and doesn't offer the flat feeling I was seeking, but it's good for reading in bed as it's not prone to flatten out.

product_metadata.title: Digital Decor Set of 2 100% Cotton Hotel Pillows - Made in USA Hypoallergenic Pillows with Down Alternative Fiber Fill for Side & Back Sleepers - Three Comfort Levels - (King, Silver/Soft)
features: SET OF 2 SLEEP PILLOWS: Indulge in the irresistible comfort of our premium sleeping pillows. Unlike most pillow producers, we give you a Set of 2 down alternative pillows that are made of 100% cotton fabric with medium virgin polyester filling. Proudly made in the USA from top quality materials.

HIGHLY BREATHABLE: To give you maximum coolness and breathability, we use a high thread count on our cotton exterior. Meaning you will have more restful nights of sleep without the usual sweat and odor that tend to appear with sleeping pillows with low thread count.

DURABLE & 100% HYPOALLERGENIC: Enjoy completely hypoallergenic material that is irritation-free. Each of our down alternative pillows is filled with 100% virgin synthetic polyester filling (the highest quality in the pillow industry). Choose between a variety of sizes (Standard, Queen, King) and firmness levels (Soft, Medium, Firm) to significantly enhance the quality of your sleep.

COMPLEMENTS ANY SLEEP POSITION: Whether you are a back, stomach, or side sleeper, delight in our pillows with a medium fill level that seamlessly adhere to your sleeping positions. Suitable for any bed, these hotel and bed pillows are ideal for all ages making them a perfect purchase for your home.

MACHINE WASHABLE & HIGH QUALITY: Wash and dry the sleep pillows in a washing machine (cold gentle cycle) and dryer (tumble dry low) with your other clothes and enjoy easy maintenance. Rest assured knowing you will be sleeping in premium quality sleeping pillows that are made under the highest standards with high-end materials here in the USA.

details.Product Care Instructions: Machine Wash Cold Gentle Cycle with Mild Detergent, Tumble Dry Low Heat
